craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra-adbhuta of tended glory through impurity — the Lord in wandering (v14 absent in data too: edition numbering gap, not a defect; L4 follows the L3 set). Vast-assumed shines + tightened-impures in one breath (paradox uncut). Rejected: (a) resolving paradox → killed: paradox is the verse. Read aloud: BLISS-spread-SELF … IM-pure IT-grows.

lines: Bliss-spread self, vast views-powers assumed, shines;
tightened own power in wandering — impure it grows.

reads_against.argmap: How does the impure shine? → Vast-assumed shines; tightened-power impures in wandering.
c1_essence: Tended means; Lord tends; release-glory proceeds.
God's five, self's five; delusion the difference.
Expansion sung capable; contraction called wanderer.
Withdrawn grace in oneness; manifesting named veiling.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of tended glory; adbhuta of actor-assumed stages; adbhuta of shining-impure; karuṇa-vīra of confessed Lord; vīra of mirrored acts; vīra of named states; adbhuta of willing māyā; karuṇa-adbhuta of graced veiling; adbhuta of jewel-near-yet-clod
